records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023 increased by $1.1 billion, or 24%, and $3.3 billion, or 25%, compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023 increased by $301.4 million, or 25%, and $1.1 billion, or 33% compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit was $1.9 billion, up 21% year over year, driven primarily by our Cash App and Square ecosystems.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in the three months ended September 30, 2023 was driven by an increase in both the average market price of bitcoin and the quantity of bitcoin sold to customers compared to the three months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the third quarter of 2023, operating loss was $9.9 million and Adjusted Operating Income was $89.7 million, a decrease of 80% and an increase of 179% year over year, respectively.
